# bloxone_federation_next_available_overlapping_blocks (Data Source)

Retrieves the next available __OverlappingBlock__ objects from the specified parent __FederatedBlock__, without allocating them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The Next Available Overlapping Block Lookups are performed under the existing Federated Block
# Here we retrieve an existing federated block
data "bloxone_federation_federated_blocks" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_federation_federated_block"
  }
}

# Preview the next available overlapping block(s) under the federated block above, without allocating them.
data "bloxone_federation_next_available_overlapping_blocks" "example" {
  id   = data.bloxone_federation_federated_blocks.example_by_attribute.results.0.id
  cidr = 24

  # Number of overlapping blocks to preview. Defaults to 1.
  overlapping_block_count = 2
}

# With the default overlapping_block_count, only one next available overlapping block is previewed.
data "bloxone_federation_next_available_overlapping_blocks" "example_default_count" {
  id   = data.bloxone_federation_federated_blocks.example_by_attribute.results.0.id
  cidr = 24
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (Number) The CIDR of the overlapping blocks to be retrieved.
- `id` (String) The resource identifier of the parent Federated Block.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) The description for the overlapping block. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `name` (String) The name to be provided.
- `overlapping_block_count` (Number) The count of overlapping blocks required. If not provided, it will default to 1.

### Read-Only

- `results` (List of String) List of next available overlapping block's addresses in the specified parent Federated Block.
